subject: Intro: Momentum Systems — demo request (partner handoff)
messages:
From: Marcel Ruiz <marcel.ruiz@integral-systems.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, alyssa@momentumsys.com
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Momentum Systems — demo request (referred by Integral Systems)

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Looping you in from Integral Systems — we recently helped Momentum Systems (Alyssa Chen, cc'd) evaluate options for low-latency inference and they completed a self-serve signup on Redwood last week. Momentum is an edge analytics startup with a hard requirement around p99 latency and predictable monthly spend. They asked us to connect them to Redwood for a short product demo and questions about Dedicated allocations.

Alyssa is the PM leading the POC. Alyssa — Soojin is our SDR who will coordinate next steps and Ben is the SE who typically runs the technical demo. Tom (Integral SA) will likely join on the partner side.

Suggested asks:
- 30–45 minute demo focused on latency, deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated), and expected cost at scale
- Bring SE + partner SA for technical Q&A

Soojin / Ben, can you propose a few slots this week or early next? Alyssa is in EDT. Thanks!

—Marcel
Partner Sales, Integral Systems
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@momentumsys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Marcel Ruiz <marcel.ruiz@integral-systems.com>, Tom Epps <tepps@integral-systems.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Momentum Systems — demo request (referred by Integral Systems)

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you, and thanks Marcel. 

We'd love to run a focused 30-min session to show the runtime, routing/fallback story, and what Dedicated looks like from an operations/cost perspective. A few slots that work for the team (all in PDT):

- Tue Apr 13, 09:00–09:30 PDT
- Tue Apr 13, 11:00–11:30 PDT
- Wed Apr 14, 14:00–14:30 PDT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my scheduling page: https://cal.com/redwood-demo/soojin (I populated default availability and will add the session to a shared calendar once confirmed).

Who should we include from Momentum (SE/infra/PM)? Also, which timezone should I show on the invite (I can send in EDT if preferable). We can include Tom from Integral if you'd like partner coverage.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference

All three slots on Apr 13 are unfortunately blocked for our team. We can do Wed Apr 14 but prefer the morning. Are you able to do Wed Apr 14 at 09:30–10:00 PDT (12:30–13:00 EDT)? I can also include our infra lead (Ravi Patel) for a quick cost/throughput question.

Tom from Integral — we appreciate you joining as well.

If Wed morning works, please send an invite in EDT for our calendar.

Best,

Attaching a short deck and an intake spreadsheet so we can capture a couple of baseline metrics ahead of the call (if you can fill the intake sheet, it helps tailor the demo).

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (12 slides), MomentumSys-intake.xlsx (simple POC metrics template)

I’ll include a Meet link in the calendar invite.
